description: This Java class represents a DrugOrder entity within the OpenMRS medical record system. It extends the Order class and includes properties related to medication prescriptions, such as dose, frequency, drug details, dosing instructions, and methods for copying, cloning, and comparing orders.

classes.name: DrugOrder
classes.description: Represents a medication order with detailed properties including dosage, frequency, drug info, and dispensing instructions within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the current DrugOrder object, including all relevant fields.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing
methods.description: Creates a new DrugOrder instance for discontinuation, copying relevant fields and setting action to DISCONTINUE.

methods.name: cloneForRevision
methods.description: Creates a revised copy of the current order for editing purposes.

methods.name: setAutoExpireDateBasedOnDuration
methods.description: Calculates and sets the auto-expiration date based on the duration and dosing instructions, if applicable.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs
methods.description: Checks whether this drug order has the same orderable as another, considering drug and concept similarities.
